question: What are the two most common first names among the school administrators? Indicate the district to which they administer.
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching the joined table record.
gold: SELECT DISTINCT T1.AdmFName1, T1.District FROM schools AS T1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT admfname1 FROM schools GROUP BY admfname1 ORDER BY COUNT(admfname1) DESC LIMIT 2) AS T2 ON T1.AdmFName1 = T2.admfname1
gold0: SELECT DISTINCT T1.AdmFName1, T1.District FROM schools AS T1 INNER JOIN ( SELECT admfname1 FROM schools GROUP BY admfname1 ORDER BY COUNT(admfname1) DESC LIMIT 2 ) AS T2 ON T1.AdmFName1 = T2.admfname1

d.request: What are the two most common first names among the school administrators, and to which district does each administrator with those names belong, including administrators who have no matching record in the joined district table (i.e., use a left join so those rows are kept)?
d.sql: SELECT T1.AdmFName1, T1.District FROM schools AS T1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT District FROM schools) AS T2 ON T1.District = T2.District WHERE T1.AdmFName1 IN (SELECT AdmFName1 FROM (SELECT AdmFName1, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM schools WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY AdmFName1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 2)) ORDER BY T1.AdmFName1, T1.District

c.request:
What are the two most common first names among the school administrators? Indicate the district to which they administer.
Also keep rows that have no matching the joined table record.
c.sql: SELECT AdmFName1, District, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM schools GROUP BY AdmFName1, District ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 2

b.request: Using a left join from the administrator first-name data to the district information, what are the two most common administrator first names (AdmFName1) across all schools, including schools with no matching district record, and which district does each administer?
b.sql: WITH top_names AS (SELECT s.AdmFName1, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM schools s LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.AdmFName1 ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 2) SELECT DISTINCT t.AdmFName1, t.cnt, f.`District Name` FROM top_names t JOIN schools s ON s.AdmFName1 = t.AdmFName1 LEFT JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode ORDER BY t.cnt DESC, t.AdmFName1, f.`District Name`
